༄༅/ /bya rog ma bstan bsrung gi skor gyi chos tshan tho yig gser gyi thur ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bya rog ma bstan bsrung gi skor gyi chos tshan tho yig gser gyi thur ma bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bde gshegs rnams kyi mthu nus rdo rje'i zhun// ma rungs 'dul blug srin po'i gzugs zhud po// mthong bas bdud bzhi'i snying kun khar 'tshang bas// stobs bkye mdun na tshugs pa med der 'dud// 'jigs pa mi zad chu srin gyis bltam pa'i// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dug lnga'i rbas dkrugs pa// 'di kha pha rol phyin pa myur byed du// mthun pa'i rlung chen g.yo 'dir gsal por byas// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyongs spel ba dang*/ g.yon can bdud kyi sde 'joms pa la gcig tu dpa' bar 'dod par dag la bsam pa lhun gyis grub par byed pa'i chos kyi sde/ dpal 'brug pa'i sgrub thabs bskor lngar grags pa'i nang tshan/ bya rog ma bstan bsrungs kyi skor gyi dpe gces pa rnyog pa med pa rnams tho yig tu 'god do// thog mar/ dngos grub 'byung 'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ thugs rje 'byung ba rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud dgos 'dod 'byung ba le'u lnga bcu pa/ spu gri klad gzir nag po dngos grub 'byung ba'i bka' brgyud le'u bcu bdun pa ste 'byung ba bzhi/ bya rog rtsegs pa dam tshig bstan pa spyi'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rdo rje gri gug rtsegs pa ye shes gsang ba rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u nyer bzhi pa/ sha za rtsegs pa'i rgyud dum bu bcu bzhi pa ste rtsegs pa gsum/ las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gsod byed srog gzir nag po zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ thod pa nag po gsang ba'i rgyud le'u nyer gsum pa ste/ nag po gnyis/ las gsang ba nam ngag gi rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u nyer gsum pa dang*/ bco lnga pa ste las gsang gnyis/ dpal nag po chen po las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gsod byed srog gi spu gri gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u nyer gsum pa dang*/

le'u bco lnga pa gnyis te 'di gnyis la drag po mtshon cha bsnol ba spu gri'i rgyud che chung zer/ khrag mtsho khol ma zhes bya ba mgon po gsang ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa dang*/ khrag mtsho khol ma gsod byed snying 'byin nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa te khrag mtsho khol ma'i rgyud che chung*/ nag po chen po snying rje khros pa'i rgyud le'u bcu drug pa/ bya gdong khros pa bzhi snying gsang ba srog gzir sbas pa'i rgyud/ kha tant+rī rgyud kyang zer ba le'u bcu bdun pa khros pa gnyis rnams pho rgyud/ me lce 'bar ma'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ me lce 'phreng ba'i rgyud dum bu gnyis pa ste me lce gnyis/ gsod byed dmar mo rtsa 'jib ma dug rlangs khol mas bsad pa'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ 'jig rten phung byed sngags rgod nag po'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa gsang ba gnyis/ e ka dzā ṭi'i sngags rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ mkha' 'gro ma snying po sdus pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ mkha' 'gro ma las tshogs 'phreng ba'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ ma mo 'jig rten gtsug lag gi rgyud las yang tig bkol ba le'u dgu pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bcud bsdus kyi rgyud dam mkha' gro drug skor gyi rgyud du grags pa le'u drug pha ma lnga'o// dug rlabs khol ma rtsa ba'i rgyud/ ro langs nag mo bshad rgyud/ sgrol byed nag mo man ngag /thod phreng nag mo skye rgyud/ khrag mtsho khol ma las tshogs/ zla gsang nag po gnad 'gag ston pa zhes kyang zer ro// rgyud de dag gi man ngag bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa la/ thog mar lo rgyus gser gyi yang zhun dang*/ stong mthun gser gyi sgrom bu gnyis chos rjes mdzad pa/ nag po chen po bya rog can phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa 'di mgon po'i man ngag thams cad kyi thog mar byung ba'i yi ge yin/

de'i 'grel pa sa bcad dang bcas pa dpal rga los mdzad pa/ nag po chen po las kyi man ngag a bhya ya ka ras mdzad pa/ 'di las las brgyad drag po'i sbyin sreg dang dgu bstan/ de'i kha skong ting nge 'dzin sngags kha sbyar dbye ba/ zhi rgyas dbang gi las gsum rdo rje gdan pa chen pos/ sbyin sreg /bsrung ba/ bzlog pa/ char dbab/ sri'u gso ba/cho 'phrul gyi phra mo'i yi ge re re/ phyi sgrub bo// bya rog can gyi nang sgrub zhes bya ba slob dpon ārya de wa mdzad pa/ gsung gi snying po'i sgrub thabs rga lo/ 'di gnyis rang rkyang du bsgrub pa'i gzhung yin/ bka' sdod can du bsgrub pa la rga los mngon rtogs tshigs bcad dang lhug pa gnyis mdzad/ de gnyis tshad mar gyur kyang dar ba dang tshigs tshogs che bas 'dir ma bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor de dang 'brel ba dbang bzhi rdzogs kyi cho ga rga los mdzad pa/ de'i kha bskongs sdom gzung*/ bka' bsgo sngags dbang gi yi ge de'i phyi ma 'di phyi sgrub gyi rjes gnang du yang mdzad/ 'brug lugs kyi rjes gnang 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ges mdzad pa/ thod nag gi bsnyen pa'i gzhung las kyi nag po chen po'i sgrub pa zhes bya ba dang*/ las kyi sbyor ba gnyis ārya de was mdzad pa/ phyi ma 'di la tsa mi'i las sbyor chen po zer phyi rabs pa 'dod pa nor ba yin las kyi sbyor ba chen po nges pa drug gi gtan la phab pa tsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags pas mdzad pa/ nges drug ma gzhan 'dis zong mar btang*/ brten bca' sbyor gzhug /sems bskyed/ mngon rtogs/ las sgrub/ thun sgrub/ gdung las/ 'bru thems gsal sgron/ dril gtor/ brtags yig rtsa 'grel/ sbobs dkrugs bcad chog /gzi mdangs sdu ba/ lha dbye/ ngag mnan yum gyis bsad pa/ beng gi dmag sgrub/ gtor 'bul zor las te phra mo srog gzir rga lo/ 'gyu byed ma/ khrag 'jib ma/ sgrol byed ma gsum gyi sger sgrub kyi gzhung gsum klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/

dug gsum mgon po'i sgrub thabs khrag tig gsang ba slob dpon a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ srog tig gshan pa bya gdong gi sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ khrag 'thung nag po'i las sbyor snying tig yang tig /gyim shang bla ma tsa mis bcug pa/ 'di rnams thod nag dang 'brel ba'i yi ge/ thod nag gi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi be bum gsum rga los ji ltar gsungs pa kho na ltar gnam rtse lding du zin bris mdzad pa/ 'di la phyi chos sdings ba rabs pas bar du bcug pa'i yi ge dar kyang khung mi thub pas 'di la gces par bya/ gces brgyad kyi rtsa 'grel zhal gdams mngon rtogs dang las byang bsdus pa bsgrub thabs le'u bdun pa nang bsgrub bo// gsang ba thugs sgrub kyi rtsa ba/ dpang lo rgyus zhal gdams rga los/ 'khor lo'i gab phyung*/ bsnyen pa'i tho yig /sgrub pa'i tho yig /'di la 'khor lo bzhi khrid zer/ las sbyor gyi tho yig gsang sgrub kyi dbang chog /dpal rga lo dang rje phag mo gru pa'i zhu lan nyi shu pa gsang ba thugs sgrub kyi gnad thang la 'bebs pa lta bu rnams/ dpal phag po gru pa'i zin bris ngo ma sku rags ma ma 'chugs pa yang dag pa yin/ gzhan rnams bsre slad can 'ba' zhig /gsang sgrub bo// sbyor ba'i 'phreng ba/ 'di la bod kyi mkhas rlom dag tsa mi'i sbyor drug tu 'dren te/ de'i lugs kyi sbyor drug logs par yod/ 'di nyid du'ang*/ lhan skyes dri med la de bzhin/ ye shes 'char ba'i man ngag ni/ cung zad bdag gis bri bar bya/ sogs ma go bar zad do// de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa'o// dkar po sku'i sgrub pa 'dus pa chen po tshe'i le'u la bsten nas rdo rje mngon shes can yang zer sau ri pa'ang zer gdan pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ de la mkho ba'i bdud kyi zhags 'grol a seng gis mdzad pa/ dmar po gsum gyi sgrub thabs la dbang sgrub dang*/

rin chen dbang gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i las tshogs gnyis slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ ser po yon tan gyi sgrub pa/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos sa ra ha yang zer bde mchog rtsa rgyud rgyas pa'i nag po'i rtog pa na 'dug pa gud du phyung pa/ ljang khu 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa la/ las brgya'i cho ga zhes bya ba dum bu gsum yod pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mgon po'i rgyud sna tshogs las phyung ba/ de'i gab 'byin gyi phra mo'i yi ge bcu/ rigs bzhi'i sgrub pa'o// 'di rnams phag mo gru pas dpal rga lo dngos la gsan pa yin/ gnad kyi chings/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs zhal shes/ bsgrub thabs gser khur ma/ gnad bzhi ma/ de'i zhal gdams gnyis/ zhal myur lta/ gtor ma'i dgra bsad chung 'bring chen po tsa mis mdzad pa/ de'i zhal shes gnyis/ dam tshig gi gtor ma rga los mdzad pa/ srog phur gyi gzhung bram ze mchod sred phyi mas mdzad pa/ dam sbrags/ spos sbyor/ nag po chen po dang e ka dza ṭī'i sbags sgrub/ sring mo bzhi bskor rga los/ gnod sbyin khrag ral can me nyag /bya khyung gi bsgrub pa bya rog can gyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa la brten nas klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i zhal gdams/ 'di rnams dpal rga los bla ma a seng min pa la ma gnang*/ de la dpal phag mo gru pas gsan/ thugs sgrub kyi skor ma gtogs gong gi skor kyang a seng la rga los gnang*/ rga los gnang ba la slob dpon 'di gnyis rgya che ba yin no// phyi gnad mgon po 'jig rten par sgrub pa dang*/ sde brgyad dang sdong nas las bkol ba le tshe brgyad pa gnyis bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ de'i bskul byang*/ nang gnad mgon po zhing skyong du sgrub pa la zhing skyong mgon po bya rog gdong can bzhis skor ba klu sgrub kyis na lenda'i rdo sku'i rtsar mdzad pa/ 'di la bka' gter gnyis yod pa'i 'di bka' ma yin/

'di'i lag len tsa mi lo tsā bas mdzad pa/ de'i las tshogs par pu chig skor/ gnyis skor gsum bskor/ gsang gnad mgon po ye shes par sgrub pa la gsang ba dam tshig gi sgrub pa a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ 'di la sku rags ma'i rtsa ba'o zer ba gab pa ma go ba yi no// gsang rten hūṃ gnyis ma zhal myur lta dang srog gi zhal gdams/ gsang ba srog gi sgrub pa rnams dpal rga los bla ma sog pa min pa la ma gnang*/ khong la de las ma gnang*/ de kha la phag mo gru pas gsan/ lo rgyus/ zhing skyong lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di rdo sku'i thugs kha nas rga los spyan drangs pas gter ma/ gsang ba rnam brgyad/ rten bca' gsum sngags kyi 'bru thems/ spog chog /than/ zlog pa/ be ta la rten pa 'i nor sgrub thod pas dbang*/ ral gris bsad pa/ kha ṭāṃ gas sku gsung thugs ye shes lam du byed pa ste phra mo re re 'di rga los bla ma gsal stong shwa re min pa la ma gnang*/ khong la 'di las ma gnang*/ de la phag grus gsan/ 'di yod rnams phag gru lugs thun mong ma yin pa/ tshal lugs la gzhung dang po gnyis ma gtogs med pa kyang yin/ steng pa lugs la'ang gzhung dang po gnyis las sbyor gyi gzhung gnyis yod/ gzhan med/ rjes gnang*/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga rin chen 'phreng 'dra zhes bya ba slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad par grags pa/ gsang ba gsung gi sgrub thabs spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa rga los mdzad pa/ gnad gdams zhang chos rjes mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro brgyad skor gyi las tshogs nag po zhabs chen pos mdzad pa/ las kyi nag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs rga lo la rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas gnang ba/ de'i las tshogs dgra bo myur du bsad pa 'gyogs byed pho nyar btang ba'i man ngag /gzhan gyi rbod gtong bzlog pa snang sring brtsad nas gcod pa'i 'khor lo rang gzhan bsrung ba khams su zil gyi gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin/

las kyi mgon po yum bcas kyi sgrub thabs khrag 'thung nag pos mdzad pa/ 'di slob dpon shanta rnying ma'i garbha yin/ las kyi nag po mkha' 'gro drug gis skor ba slob dpon nag po zhabs phyi mas mdzad pa/ 'di mkhas pa sgo drug gi gya ba a tsarya ba ling nag po yin zer/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dpal rga lo la bya gdong dngos gyi gnang ba'i shog dril bya gdong gsum gyi sger sgrub gsum gnang 'bebs/ seng gdong gi sgrub thabs rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po'i zhabs 'og nas rga los bton pa dang*/ de'i yum sgrub tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis klu sgrub phyi ma la phul ba sogs de'i skor shog dril brgyad/ nag po stong gi gtso bo bdud lcam dral/ gnod sbyin khri'i gtso bo nag po gnod sbyin ming sring*/ sha za 'bum gyi gtso bo mu stegs a se nag po rnams kyi sger sgrub rnams tsa mis shog dril gnyis gnyis/ ser ba/ jag chings/ thog gi btsan dug /rten gtor gyi bcas rgyas pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rten gtor zhang dang chos rjes mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i rnam bshad chos rjes/ gsang ba'i gsol 'debs/ gang mdzes kyi sham bu can gyi nor sgrub srog 'khor gsum yab yum las gsum rjes gnang sgrub thabs gong khug ma/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa zhang gdan sa pa'i zin bris/ 'di rnams bla ma zhang rang la rga lo dngos kyis gnang ba tshal lugs kho na/ gzhan la med/ nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi bsgrub pa/ 'di mngon 'byung gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor/ der dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen 'phreng ba/ ratna ā ka ra gu so ri pa ptas mdzad pa 'gyur 'ga' zhig las ratna a ka ra shanti pa snga ma shanti bas mdzad zer cung mi 'dra tsam gnang ste 'gyur khyad du zad/ 'di gnyis bdag gi byas pa'i mgon mangs su grags pa 'di'i rtsa ba yin/ stong mthun rnying pa rnams na klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa mgon po la legs ldan chen po bdun cu rtsa gsum gyi skor ba yod zer/

rkang brgyad rgya skad ma/ de'i rgya 'grel kyang yod zer/ rga lo'i tshigs bcad lhug 'di rnams tshal phag gnyis ka la yod/ sum dril rgyan can zhes bya ba'i gsang sgrub slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rga los mdzad pa'i de'i sgrub thabs dang zhal gdams gsum/ las sbyor gnang lnga'i yi ge/ gtor chen rnams rga los cog ro chos kyi rgyal mtshan min pa la ma gnang*/ mkha' 'gro ma nā li suryas mdzad pa'i mgon po'i sgrub thabs gzhung gcig la cha tshang pa dge bshes g.yor po min pa la ma gnang*/ khong la 'di las med/ nag po chen po yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu/ slob dpon ye shes klu sgrub la wa pa sogs grub thob bdun gyi slob ma zer te ye shes zhabs 'dra'o/ spyan bzang pos mdzad pa/ phyag mtshan la rten nas sgrub pa/ nad gdon bsrung ba/ rgyas pa'i las grub/ dbang gi las sgrub/ mngon spyod kyi las sbyor/ bskrad pa/ dbye/ rims/ smyor 'jug /cho 'phrul/ las thams cad pa'i sngags 'bum rin chen rdo rjes/ gzhan rnams tsa mis yi ger bris mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i rim pa kha che'i mkhas pa chen po rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i yig chung rnams dpal rga los khams pa slangs ston las gzhan la ma gnang*/ bya rog can phyag gnyis par sgrub pa mgon dmar rkang gling mar grags pa yig tshan gnyis rga los lho pa spre'u ston char 'bebs la gzhan don la 'byon khar gnang ba'o// paṇḍi ta bde ba'i gros kyis mdzad pa'i las kyi tsaṇṭi ka dmar mo'i shog dril lnga rga lo mya ngan las 'da' khar sregs ban la gnang ba 'di rnams rga lo lugs so// mgon po bstan pa 'di la gsung tshul/ de rgya gar du byon tshul gyi lo rgyus gnyis/ gdams ngag gsung bgros ces pa thems yig /'di las don dgur phye nas gtso bo la sgrub thabs bzhi yod ces pa'i dang po phyi sgrub rgya gzhung mthun/ de'i don steng lo nyid kyis mdzad pa/
nang sgrub kyang gzhung mthun/ de'i don steng los mdzad pa/ bya rog gdong can gyi gsang sgrub las sbyor gyi gzhung gnyis

arya de wa'i mthun/ nges pa drug gis gtan la phab pa zhes pa steng lo rang gi mdzad pa/ de'i nye bsnyen gyi mngon rtogs lag len/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i gsham na yod pa de/ phyag gnyis pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub dang*/ lo tsā bas de'i bsrung 'khor bod yig dang*/ yab sras kyi las byang gsum bla ma tsa mis sdebs pa de rnams yin/ 'khor la sgrub thabs lnga ces pa/ gnod sbyin/ ging*/ btsan/ ma mo/ klu/ de'i gnod sbyin la rnam sras zhi sgrub de wa ga ra 'am dza ya de bar grags pas mdzad pa drag sgrub des mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga de dang*/ rgyas pa tsa mis/ gsol 'debs steng lo/ rta bdag so so'i sgrub pa ba kri ma la shi la bas mdzad pa/ a bha ya yin/ ljang sngon gyi sgrub thabs steng lo/ ging rgyal po la shog dril dgu /btsan rdor legs kyi shog dril bcu bzhi/ ma mo dur khrod bdag mo'i shog dril lnga/ klu me sbal gyi las la/ khye'u mtha' yas sngags kyi sgrub pa zhes bya ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ klu me sbal nag po gsang ba sa gsor gyi gdams ngag klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'byung ba rang gshed du dbab pa'i man ngag gnyis/ dug gsum 'khor lo de'i sngags byang*/ yang sngags byang 'dre'i khang bu me sbal gyi mngon rtogs zhal gdams gsum rnams steng los/ las tshogs brgyad la tho yig bzhin gyi bdun la shog dril so so/ brgyad pa'i thugs dam bskang mdos la/ phyi srog chags kyis bskang ba/ nang gtor mdos kyis bskang ba/ gsang ba mdos bskang*/ yang gsang baṃ gyis bskang ba'o// gnad kyi gdams pa bdun dang bcas pa de rnams thams cad tsa mis mdzad pa skor gnyis la pho skor spu gri reg gcod/ khrag 'thung nag pos mdzad pa/ de'i bskul byang*/ yul skor slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'di la 'gyur mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi legs nyes snang ba las 'di legs pa yin gzhung gnyis su ma rtog shig

/de'i las tshogs kyi gzhung yang byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ de'i lag khrid tsa mis steng lo la gnang ba'o// de'i bskul byang*/ brgyad kyi bsad pa la/ nag po chen po'i phyag brnyan gza' bdud dmag dpon brgyad du bsgrub pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ des tshod nges par gzung ba zhes bya ba klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ gza' shor ba'i man ngag klu sgrub kyis/ mon po rog ti nag po'i sgrub thabs tsa mis/ don brgyad gsal ba'i sgron me tsa mis/ steng lo rang gi mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gcig /bar chad sel ba klu sgrub/ rdzas ser tsa mis/ rtags/ nor sgrub klu sgrub kyis 'gyur dus kyi yig chung bzhi phyir rabs pas mdzad pa/ bsrung ba tsa mis/ dpal nag po chen po'i mdos gsum la/ bskang mdos/ bzhi mdos su grags pa/ glud mdos sam zlog mdos bcu gsum sogs su grags pa/ raksha dgra mdos brgyad sogs su grags pa kun tsa mis mdzad pa/ 'khor la sgrub tshul gnyis zer ba ra thod dang dmar po dgra zor yin/ ra thod la lo rgyus/ lha gsum gyi gzhung bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa/ 'di khrag 'thung nag po'i slob ma/ de'i lag len lo tsā bas/ lha drug ma'i gzhung gser gling pas/ ra thod ma lha dgu sogs kyi gzhung gsum phyi rabs pas sbyar pa/ de'i zhal gdams gcig /dgab 'dre mnan pa/ lha dbye/ ar gtad/ ser ba/ bsad pa'i yi ge gsum lo tsā ba rang gis so// lha dgu dang lha bcu gnyis ma'i rgya gzhung yod zer/ dmar po dgra zor a bha ya ka ras mdzad pa'i gzhung gnyis snang ba 'gyur gyi khyad kho nar zad la 'gyur 'di legs so// mngon rtogs/ spyan 'dren/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ bskul/ gtor 'bul che ba dang*/ rten/ sngags go log /cho 'phrul/ 'khor lo'i bcas yig rnams steng pa lugs so// spu gri klad gzer nag po'i rgyud 'grel dpe 'ga' zhig tu gung thang ras pas byas zer te mi dag pa'o/ rong lings lo tsā ba rdo rje dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/

'di la ro langs rdo rje dbang phyug zer mang po byung ba ma dag pa'o// ma mo sgrub pa'i dgab mnon/ yum tsaṇḍi ka'i sgrub thabs phyi nang gi rnal 'byor pa rnams/ bgros nas mdzad pa/ de'i shog dril gsum tsa mis/ mgon po la mkha' 'gro drug gis skor ba ye shes spyan zhes bya ba a tsarya sprin gyi shugs kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i bskang mdos/ bskang chog /las kyi go rim rnams des mdzad pa/ drug bskor gyi las tshogs a bhya yas mdzad pa/ yig phran gsum rong lings lo tsā bas sbyar ba ste rong lings pa'i skor/ las gsang gi 'grel pa khe khad kyi gsung la lho brag pa dar ma seng ges zin bris byas pa/ las gsang ba'i rgyud kyi khyad par gyi gnad bstan pa khe gad 'khor lo grags rang gis mdzad pa/ sngags kyi man ngag gsang ba zhes bya ba rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i don gsal bar byed pa khe gad kyis mdzad pa/ byad 'grol dang ngag la dbang bskur gnyis slob dpon a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa rnams khe gad kyi lugs so// 'di so so nas brgyud pa thun mongs ma yin pa bkod/ gzhan sgrub thabs gsum yum skor thams cad la yod/ gsum gyi steng pa bla ma gzhan gnyis slob mar grags so// dkyil chog rin chen 'phreng 'dra'i lo rgyus/ las gsang ba'i rgyud nas phyung ba dkyil chog rin chen 'phreng 'dra slob dpon chen po zhe sdang rig pa grags kyis mdzad pa/ zhang zhung lo tsā ba'i lugs/ bal po ye rang gi bla ma ye shes rdo rje'i gdams pa lo tsā ba 'jam dpa' grags pas bris pa rin po che pa ri bas bcug par 'dug go /mang thos utpal zer 'bru'i kha'i// rnam dpyod ral gri chen po'i rno// lugs min thams cad gtub byed 'di// 'jam dbyangs rnams kyi dpung pa'i gnyen// 'dir bkod pa'i dpe rnams bar gyi gzhung tshig phal cher mthun kyang lhad bcug pas lhag pa/ chad pa du mas de la blo kha ma rdzogs nas/
